forks.source: GD lock on #255 (ticket 269): the extraction fork at P16, both branches on the mineral drain. Hauler (volume): the drain reaches reachBonusTiles further and takes as many more cells a use, its Mark magnitude; an income mover, so it stays unregistered until the 15% income-cap check (#385) merges (GD ruling on #212). Prospector (selection): the drain reads reachBonusTiles further, its Mark magnitude, and takes only the cells of the best grade in reach, best value first. Starting values for G&V to tune; both branches share one tier and slot, so they cost the same.
